metadata.data_type: Synthetic Demonstration Rasters & Biophysical Simulation Proxy
metadata.sensor_analog: Calibrated as spatial analog to ESA Copernicus Sentinel-2 MSI (B4/B8) and NASA MODIS (MOD13Q1) surface reflectance parameters
metadata.bands_modeled: Band 8 (NIR: 842 nm analog) and Band 4 (Red: 665 nm analog)
metadata.spatial_coverage: Telangana Pilot Zone (Adilabad, Nizamabad, Karimnagar, Hanamkonda, Warangal, Khammam)
metadata.temporal_coverage: 1982-2024 (Synthetic rainfall-driven biophysical simulation; genuine operational Sentinel-2 launched in 2015 and MODIS in 1999)

geotiff_layers.title: [SIMULATION] Modeled Pre-Monsoon Surface Reflectance (May)
geotiff_layers.description: Synthetically generated bare-soil and pre-monsoon canopy reflectance grid based on Deccan agro-ecological parameters.

geotiff_layers.title: [SIMULATION] Modeled Peak Kharif Canopy Flush (August)
geotiff_layers.description: Synthetically generated active vegetative canopy reflectance grid.

geotiff_layers.title: [SIMULATION] Modeled Drought Canopy Stress Scenario
geotiff_layers.description: Synthetically generated drought stress scenario demonstrating vegetative depression.

geotiff_layers.title: [SIMULATION] Modeled Negative Vegetation Anomaly
geotiff_layers.description: Spatial difference grid between normal peak flush and drought scenario.

metadata.scientific_disclosure: These rasters were generated via mathematical spatial modeling functions to test the rasterio geospatial processing engine and MapLibre UI renderer. They are NOT raw or level-2 observational satellite scenes.
